blocks.text: Biogeography, yaani paudon aur janwaron ki jughrafiyai taqseem ka mutala, dikhati hai ke duniya ke mukhtalif hisson ki zindagi ki apni irtiqai tareekh hai.

items: Milte julte jandar wasee rukawaton se alag jaghon par reh sakte hain; un ki mushabihat mushtarka buzurg aur un ke farq laakhon saal ke alag irtiqa ki taraf ishara karte hain. Kitab ki misaal African sher aur America ka mountain lion hai.

Jughrafiyai rukawaton se alag jandar milte julte mahol ke bawajood aksar bohat mukhtalif hote hain; Australia aur Tasmania, jahan kangaroo ki bohat si species bare sabzi khor hain, ke bohat se janwar kaheen aur ke janwaron se mukhtalif hain.
Jazeeron mein aksar kam lekin munfarid species hoti hain, aabad kaari ke baad jazeere par irtiqa ki wajah se.

blocks.alt: Duniya ka naqsha jis ke beech Bahr-e-Kahil (Pacific) hai aur Equator ki lakeer. African lion ka ilaqa gehra surkh: Sahara ke junoob mein Africa aur mashriqi Africa. Mountain lion ka ilaqa gehra neela: maghribi North America, Central America aur zyada tar South America. Oopar baayen 'African lion' aur daayen 'Mountain lion' ki tasweerein, teeron ke saath apne ilaqon ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 24.4: Africa aur North o South America mein sheron ki taqseem (kitab ki Figure 24.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Sheron ke baare mein
blocks.text: America ka mountain lion (puma ya cougar) African sher se mukhtalif genus ka hai; dono billi khandan ke hain, aur un ki mushtarka khasiyatein billi khandan ke mushtarka buzurg se aayi hain.

blocks.prompt: Jazeeron mein aksar munfarid species kyun hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Chand aabad kaar jazeere tak pohanchte aur wahan alag thalag irtiqa karte hain, is liye un ki nasl aisi species ban jati hai jo kaheen aur nahi milti.

items: Door door milte julte groups: mushtarka buzurg, alag irtiqa.
